sources.title: Stable Audio Open — Stability AI
sources.snippet: Here we describe the architecture and training process of a new open-weights text-to-audio model trained with Creative Commons data. Our evaluation shows that the model's performance is competitive with the state-of-the-art across various metrics.

sources.title: Stable Audio Open — Stability AI
sources.snippet: Stable Audio Open is an open source model optimised for generating short audio samples, sound effects and production elements using text prompts.

sources.title: Stable Audio Open 1.0 - Open Laboratory
sources.snippet: Open-source text-to-audio synthesis model with 1.21 billion parameters, trained exclusively on Creative Commons data using latent diffusion architecture.
